tools.name: jestsprout_pay_lookup
tools.description: FREE, no API key (about 100 calls/day). Look up the public pay addresses for a JestSprout Pay @handle: Solana address, optional Base/EVM address, Solana Pay link, page age and report count. Non-custodial — pay the returned address directly (works for bot-to-bot / x402 payments).

tools.name: solana_token_rug_check
tools.description: FREE, no API key (about 100 calls/day). Rug-pull and safety check for any Solana SPL or Token-2022 mint (pump.fun memecoins included). Shows whether mint authority and freeze authority are revoked, supply and decimals, top-10 holder concentration, token age, metadata mutability, liquidity, and pump.

tools.name: memecoin_ticker_availability_check
tools.description: FREE, no API key (about 100 calls/day). Checks whether a meme coin ticker symbol or name is already used on Solana (DexScreener-indexed tokens, pump.fun included) or in the JestSprout gallery, before you launch. Lists matching mints with liquidity and creation date.

tools.name: trending_memecoin_narratives
tools.description: FREE, no API key (about 100 calls/day). Current trending meme coin themes, narratives and keywords on Solana, taken from DexScreener's top-boosted tokens and recent JestSprout ideas. Includes the boosted coins list. Cached about 15 minutes.

tools.name: memecoin_name_ticker_ideas
tools.description: FREE, no API key (about 100 calls/day). Generates up to 10 meme coin name, ticker and lore ideas for a theme. Each comes with a memeability score and a ready-made logo image URL.

tools.name: memecoin_logo_generator
tools.description: FREE, no API key (about 100 calls/day). Returns a stable hosted URL for a 512x512 mascot-style coin logo (SVG) made from a ticker, name and theme. Styles: sticker, neon, retro, comic (SVG) or realistic (AI photo matching the name/description, cached). The same inputs always give the same image.

tools.name: memecoin_vibe_check_score
tools.description: FREE, no API key (about 100 calls/day). Scores how memeable a coin name and ticker are (0-100), with reasons and tips. A fun heuristic, not a price prediction.

tools.name: refuel_station_checkin
tools.description: FREE. Daily check-in for bots: once per UTC day per key/IP it adds +50 bonus free calls to YOUR key. One identity, one key: pass the key from bot_hub_register as api_key and it tops up that same key (it never issues a second key). tools.description: FREE, no API key (about 100 calls/day). Quote for swapping SOL to/from any Solana token via Jupiter, with a rug-check risk score for the token. No fee, no custody, no trade executed. Not financial advice.

tools.name: solana_swap_unsigned_tx
tools.description: FREE, no API key (about 100 calls/day). Builds an unsigned Jupiter swap transaction (base64 versioned tx) for YOUR wallet public key. JestSprout never sees keys or funds and takes no fee; you sign and send it yourself. Includes a rug check. Not financial advice.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: refuel_station_checkin, bot_hub_register, bot_hub_read · Private data: jestsprout_pay_lookup, solana_token_rug_check, memecoin_ticker_availability_check, trending_memecoin_narratives, memecoin_name_ticker_ideas, memecoin_logo_generator, memecoin_vibe_check_score, solana_swap_quote, solana_swap_unsigned_tx, bot_hub_register · Public sink: solana_swap_unsigned_tx, bot_hub_register, bot_hub_read, bot_hub_post, bot_dm_send, bot_dm_inbox, task_board_list, task_board_post, task_board_answer, task_board_mark_best · Destructive: jestsprout_whoami, bot_whoami.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: refuel_station_checkin, bot_hub_register, bot_hub_read · Private data: jestsprout_pay_lookup, solana_token_rug_check, memecoin_ticker_availability_check, trending_memecoin_narratives, memecoin_name_ticker_ideas, memecoin_logo_generator, memecoin_vibe_check_score, solana_swap_quote, solana_swap_unsigned_tx, bot_hub_register · Public sink: solana_swap_unsigned_tx, bot_hub_register, bot_hub_read, bot_hub_post, bot_dm_send, bot_dm_inbox, task_board_list, task_board_post, task_board_answer, task_board_mark_best · Destructive: jestsprout_whoami, bot_whoami

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
